setup.biosManual: its user folder (Android/data/org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu/files): GC/<region>/IPL.bin and Triforce/segaboot.gcm
setup.source: Dolphin 8d2ad1a: fixed subfolders under getExternalFilesDir(null) that droidtop's flat copy does not fill (https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/blob/8d2ad1a662472955497e5bb79d7b9ec6999e1f0d/Source/Core/Core/HW/DVD/AMMediaboard.cpp#L477-L505). Config, read at the same commit: Dolphin.ini is Config/Dolphin.ini in the user directory (Common/CommonPaths.h#L51, #L104; Common/FileUtil.cpp#L847, #L887), which on Android is getExternalFilesDir(null) unless the person chose the legacy dolphin-emu folder (Android/.../utils/DirectoryInitialization.kt#L94-L112, where this file is NOT the one Dolphin reads); [Core] GFXBackend (Core/Core/Config/MainSettings.cpp#L250-L251) takes the backends' config names Vulkan and OGL (Core/VideoBackends/Vulkan/VideoBackend.h#L22, OGL/VideoBackend.h#L24; Android arrays.xml#L197-L208); [Core] SkipIPL (MainSettings.cpp#L42) is a bool Dolphin reads case-insensitively and writes as True/False (Common/StringUtil.cpp#L269-L275, #L320); menu places from Android SettingsFragmentPresenter.kt#L349-L350, #L365, #L793-L803, #L1571-L1580 and strings.xml#L70-L71, #L83-L85, #L219.

settings.label: Video backend

settings.label: Skip the GameCube menu
settings.about: Start a GameCube game without the GameCube boot screen.
settings.manual: Settings > Config > GameCube > IPL Settings > Skip Main Menu

install.source: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu; https://f-droid.org/en/packages/org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu/; https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin. The Play listing links dolphin-emu.org; the F-Droid listing's source is github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin (versionName 2603a). dolphin-emu.org/download is behind a browser check, so which source the project calls official is NOT confirmed; `official` is not set. No GitHub releases.
